name: OMNI404 transfer treats small amounts as ERC-721 ids and pays a full unit per Uniswap V3 exact-output swap
summary: O404.transfer(to, valueOrId) treats any value up to maxTotalSupplyERC721 (50) as an ERC-721 id and, if the caller owns that id, moves a full 1e18 ERC-20 unit plus the NFT. A Uniswap V3 pool pays swap output with transfer(recipient, amountOut). The attacker flash-borrowed O404 from the O404/WETH pool and repaid it through id transfers, leaving the pool owning ids 1..21. It then swapped exact outputs of id-many wei, receiving 1e18 O404 per id for about 2 wei of WETH, and sold the O404 back for the pool's WETH, repeating across four transactions.
notes: Direct immutable OMNI404 runtime (no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT). The owner's later writes are setWhitelist(pool) at 19195556, LayerZero setPeer calls and setBaseURI; the whitelist only stops the pool's balance from minting its own NFTs (without it the pool would hold low ids directly), so it is not necessary to the id/amount confusion.

Net WETH depletion of the O404/WETH Uniswap V3 pool 0xb3f613b9bc84ddb29d78fa4685b01d98412bba0b across the attacker's run() (source-1, 2.427003380901677080) and three drain() calls in the same block (source-2..4: 0.368159024646616381, 0.148862125724857290, 0.080539588011933639), net of the attacker's WETH inputs; the Balancer flash loan is financing.
